Dear Editor,  

We sincerely thank you, the Associate Editor, and the reviewers for the time and effort devoted to evaluating our manuscript *“Random effects on numbers-at-age transitions implicitly account for movement dynamics and improve stock assessment and management” (CJFAS-2025-0092)*. We are very pleased that the manuscript has been accepted for publication after minor revision.  

We confirm that all requested revisions have been incorporated in the final version of the manuscript. In addition, the data and code underlying this study are publicly available at:  
- GitHub: [https://github.com/lichengxue/Bias_Correction_Project](https://github.com/lichengxue/Bias_Correction_Project)

Thank you again for your support throughout the review process.  

Sincerely,  

Chengxue Li (Corresponding Author)
